snippet.title: Deadly Harvest Trailer
snippet.description:
Defend your farm from an invasion of evil pumpkins in this spooky casual roguelite! Upgrade your weapons and retrieve mystical artifacts to keep the horde at bay and uncover the secret to defeating the legendary Headless Horseman.

Available on Steam and Itch.io
